headword: {救急病院|きゅうきゅうびょういん}
reading: きゅうきゅうびょういん

definitions.explanation: A hospital designated to accept emergency patients around the clock. In Japan, hospitals are officially classified into tiers ({一次|いちじ}、{二次|にじ}、{三次|さんじ}) based on the severity of cases they handle.

examples.japanese: {救急病院|きゅうきゅうびょういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}ばれた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: I was taken to an emergency hospital.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{救急病院|きゅうきゅうびょういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べて→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧おく。
examples.english: I'll look up nearby emergency hospitals in advance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{救急病院|きゅうきゅうびょういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}して→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I developed a fever in the middle of the night, so I called the emergency hospital for advice.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧ (emergency) + ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧ (hospital). Refers to hospitals that take walk-in or ambulance-brought emergency cases at any hour.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {救急病院|きゅうきゅうびょういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧: to take (someone) to an emergency hospital
- {救急病院|きゅうきゅうびょういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be seen at an emergency hospital
- {救急病院|きゅうきゅうびょういん}⟦{当番|とうばん}→当番：04564_touban⟧: emergency hospital on-call rotation

RELATED WORDS:
- {救急外来|きゅうきゅうがいらい}: emergency outpatient department (the ER itself within a hospital)
- ⟦{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}→救急車：05077_kyuukyuusha⟧: ambulance
- {一次|いちじ}⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧ / {二次|にじ}⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧ / {三次|さんじ}⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧: primary / secondary / tertiary emergency care (Japan's tiered system)
